 ===============================================================================
 PARAMETRIC SURVIVAL MODEL COMPARISON AND VALIDATION
 ===============================================================================
 This file displays results from parametric survival model fitting and comparison
 Shows AIC/BIC comparisons, reference values, and biomarker-specific plots
 ===============================================================================

# Start-up
```{r}
# load required packages
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
library(pacman)
p_load(survival, flexsurv, dplyr, ggplot2, scales)

# load results and run analysis if needed
setwd("../../..") 
if (!exists("models")) {
  cat("Running main parametric survival analysis...\n")
  source("scripts/R/analysis/02_setup_and_global_variables.R")
  source("scripts/R/analysis/03_biomarker_strategies.R") 
  source("scripts/R/analysis/06_parametric_survival analysis.R")
}
```

```{r}

  cat("- crp:", ref_crp, "(0=negative, 1=positive)\n") 
  cat("- tlr:", ref_tlr, "(0=negative, 1=positive)\n")
  cat("- tmb_braf:", ref_tmb_braf, "(0=negative, 1=positive)\n\n")
  
  # treatment assignments
  cat("treatment assignments:\n")
  cat("- control treatment:", ctrl_rx, "\n")
  cat("- experimental treatment:", exp_rx, "\n\n")
  
  # biomarker prevalences
  cat("biomarker prevalences in population:\n")
  for (strategy in strategies_df$id[strategies_df$id != "control"]) {
    prevalence <- strategies_df$prevalence[strategies_df$id == strategy]
    cat("- ", toupper(strategy), " positive:", round(prevalence * 100, 1), "%\n")
  }
  
  # data completeness
  cat("\ndata completeness:\n")
  cat("- complete cases used:", nrow(data_complete), "of", nrow(data), "observations")
  cat(" (", round(nrow(data_complete)/nrow(data) * 100, 1), "%)\n\n")
  
} else {
  cat("reference values not available. run main analysis first.\n")
}
```

# GOF via AIC comparison

AIC is more appropriate here because:
-BIC penalizes model complexity more heavily (uses log(n) vs 2 for AIC)
-For prediction purposes, we want the model that best balances fit and complexity
-BIC tends to select overly simple models that might miss important biomarker interactions
-AIC is better for predictive modeling while BIC is better for identifying the "true" model
```{r}
if (exists("models") && !is.null(models$full)) {
  
  cat("model fit comparison using AIC/BIC\n")
  cat("==================================\n\n")
  
  # overall survival models
  cat("overall survival (OS) models:\n")
  cat("-----------------------------\n")
  
  os_comparison <- rbind(
    data.frame(Structure = "Full", models$full$os_ic),
    data.frame(Structure = "No Age/Sex", models$no_age_sex$os_ic)
  )
  
  os_comparison <- os_comparison[order(os_comparison$AIC, na.last = TRUE), ]
  valid_aic <- !is.na(os_comparison$AIC)
  os_comparison$AIC_Rank <- NA
  os_comparison$AIC_Rank[valid_aic] <- rank(os_comparison$AIC[valid_aic])
  os_comparison$AIC <- round(os_comparison$AIC, 2)
  os_comparison$BIC <- round(os_comparison$BIC, 2)
  
  if (exists("models") && !is.null(models$best_fit$os_aic)) {
    best_idx <- which.min(abs(os_comparison$AIC - models$best_fit$os_aic))
    if (length(best_idx) > 0) {
      os_comparison$Selected <- ""
      os_comparison$Selected[best_idx] <- "***"
    }
  }
  
  print(os_comparison)
  
  # progression-free survival models
  cat("\nprogression-free survival (PFS) models:\n")
  cat("---------------------------------------\n")
  
  pfs_comparison <- rbind(
    data.frame(Structure = "Full", models$full$pfs_ic),
    data.frame(Structure = "No Age/Sex", models$no_age_sex$pfs_ic)
  )
  
  pfs_comparison <- pfs_comparison[order(pfs_comparison$AIC, na.last = TRUE), ]
  valid_aic <- !is.na(pfs_comparison$AIC)
  pfs_comparison$AIC_Rank <- NA
  pfs_comparison$AIC_Rank[valid_aic] <- rank(pfs_comparison$AIC[valid_aic])
  pfs_comparison$AIC <- round(pfs_comparison$AIC, 2)
  pfs_comparison$BIC <- round(pfs_comparison$BIC, 2)
  
  if (exists("models") && !is.null(models$best_fit$pfs_aic)) {
    best_idx <- which.min(abs(pfs_comparison$AIC - models$best_fit$pfs_aic))
    if (length(best_idx) > 0) {
      pfs_comparison$Selected <- ""
      pfs_comparison$Selected[best_idx] <- "***"
    }
  }
  
  print(pfs_comparison)
  
  # selected models summary
  cat("\nselected best-fitting models:\n")
  cat("-----------------------------\n")
  if (exists("models") && !is.null(models$best_fit$os)) {
    cat("OS: ", models$best_fit$os_structure, " structure, ", models$best_fit$os_distribution, 
        " distribution (AIC = ", round(models$best_fit$os_aic, 2), ")\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (exists("models") && !is.null(models$best_fit$pfs)) {
    cat("PFS: ", models$best_fit$pfs_structure, " structure, ", models$best_fit$pfs_distribution,
        " distribution (AIC = ", round(models$best_fit$pfs_aic, 2), ")\n", sep = "")
  }
  
} else {
  cat("model comparison tables not available.\n")
}
```

# Population survival curves
```{r}
# function to create population survival plots
create_population_plots <- function(models, data_complete, time_points, outcome_type = "OS") {
  
  cat("Debug: Starting create_population_plots for", outcome_type, "\n")
  
  # get kaplan-meier estimates
  if (outcome_type == "OS") {
    km_fit <- survfit(Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ 1, data = data_complete)
  } else {
    km_fit <- survfit(Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ 1, data = data_complete)
  }
  
  # create plotting data for km
  km_data <- data.frame(
    time = km_fit$time,
    survival = km_fit$surv,
    lower = km_fit$lower,
    upper = km_fit$upper,
    model = "Kaplan-Meier",
    structure = "Observed"
  )
  
  plot_data <- km_data
  cat("Debug: KM data rows:", nrow(km_data), "\n")
  
  # create representative patient (modal categories + mean age)
  ref_patient <- data.frame(
    Age = mean(data_complete$Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sex = get_modal_category(data_complete$sex),
    Rx = get_modal_category(data_complete$Rx),
    crp = get_modal_category(data_complete$crp),
    tlr = get_modal_category(data_complete$tlr),
    tmb_braf = get_modal_category(data_complete$tmb_braf)
  )
  
  # ensure factors have correct levels
  ref_patient$sex <- factor(ref_patient$sex, levels = levels(data_complete$sex))
  ref_patient$Rx <- factor(ref_patient$Rx, levels = levels(data_complete$Rx))
  ref_patient$crp <- factor(ref_patient$crp, levels = levels(data_complete$crp))
  ref_patient$tlr <- factor(ref_patient$tlr, levels = levels(data_complete$tlr))
  ref_patient$tmb_braf <- factor(ref_patient$tmb_braf, levels = levels(data_complete$tmb_braf))
  
  cat("Debug: Reference patient created\n")
  print(ref_patient)
  
  # add parametric model predictions
  for (structure in c("full", "no_age_sex")) {
    cat("Debug: Processing structure:", structure, "\n")
    structure_models <- models[[structure]]
    outcome_models <- if (outcome_type == "OS") structure_models$os else structure_models$pfs
    
    cat("Debug: Available models in", structure, ":", names(outcome_models), "\n")
    
    for (dist_name in names(outcome_models)) {
      model_obj <- outcome_models[[dist_name]]
      
      if (inherits(model_obj, "flexsurvreg")) {
        cat("Debug: Processing", structure, dist_name, "\n")
        tryCatch({
          # Check if model has data attached (it shouldn't due to stripping)
          # Temporarily attach data for prediction
          model_obj$data <- data_complete
          
          # use summary() method for flexsurvreg objects
          pred_summary <- summary(model_obj, t = time_points, newdata = ref_patient, type = "survival")
          
          cat("Debug: Prediction summary class:", class(pred_summary), "\n")
          cat("Debug: Prediction summary names:", names(pred_summary), "\n")
          
          if (is.data.frame(pred_summary) && "est" %in% names(pred_summary)) {
            temp_data <- data.frame(
              time = time_points,
              survival = pred_summary$est,
              lower = if("lcl" %in% names(pred_summary)) pred_summary$lcl else NA,
              upper = if("ucl" %in% names(pred_summary)) pred_summary$ucl else NA,
              model = dist_name,
              structure = structure
            )
            
            plot_data <- rbind(plot_data, temp_data)
            cat("Debug: Successfully added", nrow(temp_data), "rows for", structure, dist_name, "\n")
          } else {
            cat("Debug: pred_summary doesn't have expected structure\n")
            str(pred_summary)
          }
          
          # Remove data again to keep models clean
          model_obj$data <- NULL
          
        }, error = function(e) {
          cat("Error with", structure, dist_name, ":", e$message, "\n")
        })
      } else {
        cat("Debug:", structure, dist_name, "is not a flexsurvreg object, class:", class(model_obj), "\n")
      }
    }
  }
  
  cat("Debug: Final plot_data rows:", nrow(plot_data), "\n")
  cat("Debug: Unique models:", unique(plot_data$model), "\n")
  cat("Debug: Unique structures:", unique(plot_data$structure), "\n")
  
  return(plot_data)
}

# generate and display population curves
if (exists("models") && exists("data_complete")) {
  
  cat("\npopulation survival curves\n")
  cat("==========================\n")
  
  # First, let's check what models we actually have
  cat("Debug: Checking available models...\n")
  cat("Full OS models:", names(models$full$os), "\n")
  cat("Full PFS models:", names(models$full$pfs), "\n")
  
  # Check if any models are actually flexsurvreg objects
  for (dist in names(models$full$os)) {
    cat("Full OS", dist, "class:", class(models$full$os[[dist]]), "\n")
  }
  
  # os curves - full models
  cat("generating OS curves for full models...\n")
  os_full_data <- create_population_plots(models, data_complete, time_points, "OS")
  
  if (nrow(os_full_data) > 0) {
    os_full_data <- os_full_data[os_full_data$structure %in% c("Observed", "full"), ]
    
    cat("Debug: OS full data after filtering:", nrow(os_full_data), "rows\n")
    cat("Debug: Models in filtered data:", unique(os_full_data$model), "\n")
    
    if (nrow(os_full_data) > 0) {
      p_os_full <- ggplot(os_full_data, aes(x = time, y = survival, color = model)) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
        {if(any(!is.na(os_full_data$lower))) geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.3, color = NA)} +
        theme_minimal() +
        labs(title = "Overall Survival - Full Models vs Kaplan-Meier",
             x = "Time (weeks)", y = "Survival Probability") +
        scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
        theme(legend.position = "bottom")
      
      print(p_os_full)
    } else {
      cat("No full models data after filtering\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("No data available for OS full models plot\n")
  }
}
```

# Biomarker-specific survival plots
```{r}
# source plotting functions and execute
if (exists("predictions") && exists("strategies_df") && exists("time_points")) {
  
  cat("\nbiomarker-specific survival plots\n")
  cat("=================================\n")
  
  # source plotting functions
  setwd("../../..") 
  source("scripts/R/functions/survival_plots.R")
  
  # generate plots (moved from survival_plots.R auto-execution)
  survival_plots <- list()
  biomarkers <- strategies_df$id[strategies_df$id != "control"]
  
  for (biomarker in biomarkers) {
    cat("creating plots for", toupper(biomarker), "...\n")
    
    # os plot
    os_plot <- plot_biomarker_survival(
      predictions = predictions,
      biomarker_name = biomarker,
      outcome_type = "OS",
      time_points = time_points
    )
    
    if (!is.null(os_plot)) {
      survival_plots[[paste0(biomarker, "_os")]] <- os_plot
      print(os_plot)
      cat("  - OS plot created\n")
    }
    
    # pfs plot
    pfs_plot <- plot_biomarker_survival(
      predictions = predictions, 
      biomarker_name = biomarker,
      outcome_type = "PFS",
      time_points = time_points
    )
    
    if (!is.null(pfs_plot)) {
      survival_plots[[paste0(biomarker, "_pfs")]] <- pfs_plot
      print(pfs_plot)
      cat("  - PFS plot created\n")
    }
  }
  
  cat("total plots generated:", length(survival_plots), "\n")
}

cat("\nvalidation complete.\n")
```
